disposition: two patients reported with gunshot wounds; perimeter set; scene secured
summary: Officers and firefighters were sent to a residence in the 5400 block of Pembroke Avenue for a report of a shooting. Crews found two patients with gunshot wounds and set up a perimeter around the block, holding family members back while units went in. Hall Ambulance staged to enter from the east and officers asked firefighters to light up the roof to check it for evidence, with the scene handed to investigators.

disposition: suspect found at the back of the property; injuries still being confirmed
summary: Deputies were sent to the 1500 block of Lincoln Street for a fight involving a knife. Callers reported a man chasing a woman down the street and attacking others, and traffic indicated his mother was threatened with the knife and a sister put herself in front of it. Deputies found the suspect in a cluttered shed area at the back corner of the property and were still sorting out who was hurt. A separate 911 call nearby reported only a verbal disturbance, and the woman denied anything on callback.

area: College Avenue and Flint Ridge area
disposition: four subjects bailed out; one at large
summary: Officers picked up a newer white Honda Accord reported stolen and moved to stop it near College Avenue and Flint Ridge. About four people got out and ran into an open garage, which was then pulled shut, and officers ringed the block in case the car started moving again. One man was described running southbound in a gray shirt, black shorts and a face covering toward Culver and Pioneer. A second stolen-vehicle report, a white Honda Accord seen near Niles Road and McCurdy Drive, came in the same night.

disposition: man with a knife taken into custody
summary: Officers responded to the Food Maxx on Niles Street for a man with a knife, and a negotiator opened a line with him, calling for him to put the weapon down. The man was described as white, in his late thirties, dressed in black and carrying a pocket knife. Units were moved in from Lamont to cover the area while the call was worked.

area: the 1500 block of Taft Highway, near the Lowe's Travel Stop
disposition: suspect reported at the bus stop; caller standing by
summary: Deputies were sent to the Lowe's Travel Stop on Taft Highway for a strong-arm robbery that had just happened. The suspect was described as a 44-year-old man in a black shirt and gray pants who was still in the area at a bus stop near the Southland RV Park. The caller waited nearby to meet with deputies.
A domestic disturbance was reported in the 4400 block of Hillsboro Drive involving a teenage stepdaughter and her mother.
Commercial burglary alarms drew units to a business on Truxton Avenue and then to two addresses on Commerce Drive just south of it.

area: South Mount Vernon Avenue and Planz Road
summary: A company was sent to an outside fire at South Mount Vernon Avenue and Planz Road.
A crew handled a public service lift assist on the 500 block of Jackson Street.

disposition: driver put out his own fire; tow requested
summary: A semi on the left-hand shoulder had put out a fire on its own but was left disabled and needed a tow to the TA center.

area: the Shell station on Stockdale Highway
summary: An audible alarm came in from the Shell station on Stockdale Highway.

area: the 800 block of West Moyer Avenue
summary: Medics were asked to stand by for a medical aid on the 800 block of West Moyer Avenue.

area: Chester Lane and Lake Adams Street
summary: Crews were sent to Chester Lane and Lake Adams Street for an overdose; the patient was not breathing and CPR was in progress when the first unit arrived.
Officers worked to contact a victim at an apartment building on the 1000 block of Baker Street as part of an ongoing call.
Crews checked a facility alarm and found it all clear of smoke and fire, with a malfunctioning detector blamed.

disposition: suspect at the complex; call pending
summary: Deputies were sent to the 3000 block of Sierra Highway for a man under the influence who was in a shouting match with a neighbor and tried to assault the caller at an apartment complex.

area: the Valero on Buck Owens Boulevard
disposition: driver reported passed out behind the wheel
summary: A caller reported a driver passed out behind the wheel of a black Chevrolet pickup at the Valero on Buck Owens Boulevard, saying he had been sitting there for about three hours and kept nodding off.
Deputies checked a suspicious circumstance on the 5000 block of Pamela Street involving a man in his twenties in a white shirt and jeans.

area: Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Boulevard
summary: Firefighters handled an outside fire across from a home on Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Boulevard that may have started at a transient camp.
Deputies checked on a woman who locked herself inside a disabled car on the 500 block of Castor Lane after a man made crude comments to her. She was uncooperative with the call.
Officers were sent to the 600 block of Columbus Street for an intoxicated man carrying a hammer or mallet, seen on a neighbor's camera.

area: near a church off Olive Drive
summary: Officers searched for a man in a green shirt and shorts who was still holding a knife near a church off Olive Drive.
Deputies were sent to the 3100 block of River Boulevard for a domestic disturbance.
A broadcast went out for an armed and injured suspect wanted on a felony weapons warrant out of another agency, last seen in a white Mercedes sedan near Pyramid Lake.

disposition: doors secure; no forced entry found
summary: Deputies checked a possible break-in at a business on Standard Road near Coffee Road, where a fence had been cut and tools were left near the entrance, with a power outage in the area. The business doors were found secure with no signs of forced entry.
Officers were sent to the 2000 block of Oscar Avenue for a verbal disturbance reported near a parked GMC.
Officers recovered a stolen red Hyundai four-door on the 200 block of East 5th Street. The car was unoccupied, though the caller said someone had been getting in and out of it.
A crew was sent to a grass fire on the 400 block of Shaw Avenue.
Deputies were sent to the 1000 block of Jeffrey Street for a domestic violence check.
An audible burglary alarm drew officers to a business on the 4200 block of Easton Drive, and a second alarm came in at a restaurant on the 6000 block of Coffee Road.
Deputies were sent to the 4400 block of Hughes Lane for a domestic disturbance where a shirtless man was intimidating the caller.

area: a fire station on Stockdale Highway
disposition: juvenile taken in; medics and deputies called
summary: A 15-year-old girl walked into a fire station on Stockdale Highway upset after leaving a group home, and medics and deputies were called to the station.

area: the 1900 block of East Brundage Lane
summary: Officers were sent to the 1900 block of East Brundage Lane for a verbal disturbance among four people.
A man in a hospital gown was dropped off by a gray SUV that sped away on the 900 block of Olive Drive and then refused to leave the area.
Medics were sent to an apartment on the 500 block of Oildale Drive for difficulty breathing.
